short: Inner alias loading and SELECT savings per step

statements.markdown: It keeps a $126$-qubit one-hot register for $(r,c)$ and a $5$-bit binary register for $b$
statements.note: The lookup returns a five-bit alternate index and a nine-bit keep threshold. Addresses 30 and 31 have zero amplitude in the preparation, so each lookup column can set these values to the parities of the valid even and odd addresses. The Boolean polynomial then has zero coefficients at masks 30 and 31. The compiled lookup uses 33 scratch qubits and 390 T gates.

statements.markdown: accounts for $96\%$ of the $T$ gates saved per walk step
statements.note: Each alias lookup saves 1,578 T gates. The full inner preparation saves 3,624 per step in Table S3 and the two SELECT calls save another 14,052. The net saving of 18,398 T gates includes the extra 176 for index decoding and the savings from spin swaps and outer preparation. The two larger savings account for 96.1% in the first eight blocks.
